text: I hit a wall halfway through my Python certification last month. The logic puzzles started feeling like a foreign language, and I eventually closed the tab and didn't touch it for three weeks. I felt like a failure, but instead of quitting, I decided to scale back. I stopped trying to do an hour a day and committed to just fifteen minutes of video every morning with my coffee. That small shift turned the mountain back into a series of manageable steps. I finally finished yesterday.
